author: CNET
description:
Sit back, relax and enjoy the pleasantly distinctive sounds of an iPhone Duo being folded and unfolded hundreds of thousands of times in CNET's custom-built Fold-a-Phone machine at the CNET Labs in Louisville, Kentucky. Please enjoy eight hours of Fold-a-Phone ASMR.

Read more about the Fold-a-Phone on CNET.com
